verdict.rationale: AiPrise says compliance teams edit the onboarding flow from the dashboard without engineering tickets or deploys. It also offers scoring thresholds tunable per segment or geography and case routing to Enhanced Due Diligence, which covers no-code template changes and risk-based routing. Explicit no-code conditional branching between steps and per-country required-document rules are not documented, and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented no-code conditional step logic, explicit country-specific requirement configuration, confirmation that thresholds and routing are set in the dashboard rather than via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy

citations.quote: Compliance edits the onboarding flow from the dashboard. No engineering tickets, no deploys.
Scoring drives auto-decisioning, with thresholds tunable per segment, geography, or product line.
Every case has an owner: assign to an analyst or route to Enhanced Due Diligence.
Make dedicated verification flows required as per your custom needs.
